en: The postcard depicts a town square bordered by historic buildings, with signs in German visible on several storefronts. Notably, there is a large building on the right labeled 'Hotel Rheinischer Hof.' The street is relatively empty, with only a few people visible, and the scene is rendered in black and white, suggesting an early 20th-century origin. The caption in red at the top reads 'Roßwein. Marktplatz.'
